question: Should QQBot gateway frames be capped at 1 MiB, or should the channel retain a larger compatibility margin such as the 16 MiB gateway precedent?
rationale: The patch proves that `ws.maxPayload` enforces the boundary, but neither the platform documentation nor the supplied proof establishes the largest legitimate QQBot event; choosing when to disconnect users requires channel-owner intent.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB
options.body: Land the tighter cap after rebasing if QQBot ownership accepts disconnecting any event above 1 MiB based on platform or production evidence.

options.title: Use a larger margin
options.body: Adopt a documented higher cap such as 16 MiB to retain more compatibility headroom while still replacing the upstream 100 MiB default.

options.title: Wait for event evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open until authenticated or representative event-size evidence establishes a defensible ceiling.

recommendation.title: Use a larger margin
recommendation.body: Adopt a documented higher cap such as 16 MiB to retain more compatibility headroom while still replacing the upstream 100 MiB default.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed and proved the same QQBot WebSocket factory and are the strongest available current-history routing candidate.
